faq.title: Questions that come up in every first conversation
faq.subtitle: Five answers so our 30-minute call can focus on your situation.

q1.question: How is Clyde different from ChatGPT or Jasper?
q1.answer: ChatGPT and Jasper are generic tools without memory. You have to supply context with every prompt. Clyde has a separate memory for each client: brand voice, audience, goals and working agreements are kept. On top of that, Clyde orchestrates ten live skills plus two coming soon (social, blogs, ads, email, lead qualification, SEO, analytics and more), not just text. One brain with shared memory, not a separate tool per task.

q2.question: What if I want to cancel?
q2.answer: You're not locked in. What Clyde knows about your clients is yours. After cancellation you have 30 days to take your data with you; after that we delete your workspaces. Your data sits on servers and in a database in the EU.

q3.question: Why an application? Why no self-service?
q3.answer: Clyde is a high-touch AI partnership, not a SaaS tool. Every client gets personal onboarding by Daley (founder) and 4 weeks of partnership setup. We accept a maximum of {maxPartners} new agencies per year. The application is not there to reject you: we check together whether it is a match for both sides. A generic sign-up doesn't fit what we deliver.

q4.question: Exactly how many skills do I get?
q4.answer: Twelve in total: 10 live (Social Media, Blog Factory, Ad Manager, Lead Qualifier, Email Management, ManyChat DM, Reporting, SEO/GEO, Research, Clyde orchestrator) and 2 coming soon (Voice Agent, Reel Builder). Every plan uses all live skills; caps apply to the heavier ones, except on Enterprise.

q5.question: Why does this work better for agencies than separate tools?
q5.answer: Because it is one brain with shared memory, not 12 separate tools. What Clyde learns about a client in social media, he also uses in that client's blogs and ads. With separate tools you lose that context at every handover. One colleague for your whole portfolio means that what he knows about a client travels between skills.

q1.question: Why caps per skill instead of "everything unlimited"?
q1.answer: Voice, Video Ads and Reel Builder are the most expensive skills in credit usage (5 to 25 credits per action). Unlimited on every tier would lead to astronomical prices, or to fair-use throttling behind the scenes. Caps keep costs predictable and give each tier a natural upgrade trigger.

q2.question: What happens if I go over my credits or caps?
q2.answer: When your credits run out, Clyde stops taking actions that cost credits. You then choose: wait until next month, buy a credit pack (Mini Top-Up €39 to Max €697), or upgrade to a higher tier. No automatic overage, no surprise on your invoice.

q3.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade between tiers?
q3.answer: Upgrading is possible at any time. Downgrading takes effect at the next billing cycle. You cannot drop below Founding: your Founding price stays valid for life as long as you remain active.

q4.question: Do I get all skills or a subset?
q4.answer: Every tier gets all skills: 10 live today, Voice Agent and Reel Builder to follow. Caps per tier apply to the heavier ones. Founding's caps sit between Growth and Professional, for €997 for life. Enterprise has no caps (fair use).

q5.question: What is included in the onboarding fee?
q5.answer: The one-time onboarding fee covers 4 weeks of partnership setup by Daley: brand voice intake per brand, KPI definitions, skill configuration, test runs and approval workflow setup. It is not a technical installation fee: it is an investment in a colleague who actually runs with your team.

q6.question: Can I cancel or pause mid-term?
q6.answer: Every tier has monthly cancellation rights: you end at the next billing cycle, without a fee. Pausing is possible by arrangement, with your tier price preserved. Founding members cannot pause without losing their lifetime price: that is the nature of the Founding contract.

q7.question: What exactly happens when I downgrade?
q7.answer: Downgrading takes effect at the next billing cycle. Your clients, their memory and your settings stay in place; from then on the caps of the lower tier apply. You cannot downgrade from Founding: doing so permanently forfeits the lifetime price.

q8.question: Who owns the data and can I export it?

privacy.content: This privacy policy describes how Future Marketing AI (FutureMarketingAI) collects, uses, stores and protects personal data in connection with our platform around Clyde, the AI colleague for agencies. FutureMarketingAI is committed to protecting the privacy of our subscribers, their clients and end users, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Dutch data protection laws. This policy applies to all data processed through our platform and website.

data_collected.title: 1. Data we collect
data_collected.content: We collect the following categories of personal data: Account data (name, email address, company name, billing information), Client workspace data (brand voice documents, social media account connections, content schedules, audience profiles), Usage data (platform activity logs, feature usage, execution counts), AI interaction data (messages to Clyde in the dashboard, via WhatsApp or Telegram, content creation assignments, and recordings and transcripts of meetings Clyde attends at your request), Channel data (messages and comments on connected Instagram accounts and conversations with the chatbot on client websites) and Website data (what you fill in on the application, contact or newsletter form and in the AI Readiness Scan). We do not intentionally collect special categories of personal data (special categories under GDPR Article 9).

purpose_of_processing.title: 2. Purpose of processing
purpose_of_processing.content: We process personal data for the following purposes: providing the services of Clyde, the AI colleague for agencies (content creation, social media management, replying to messages on connected channels, lead qualification, ad creation, research and SEO, reporting), improving service quality and AI performance through aggregated usage analysis, billing and subscription management, providing technical support and customer service, and complying with legal obligations including tax, accounting and regulatory requirements.

legal_basis.title: 3. Legal basis
legal_basis.content: Our processing of personal data is based on the following legal grounds: performance of a contract (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)) for providing our subscribed services, legitimate interest (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)) for service improvement, security monitoring and fraud prevention, consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)) for analytics cookies and optional marketing communications, and legal obligation (GDPR Article 6(1)(c)) for tax and regulatory compliance.

ai_data_processing.title: 4. AI data processing
ai_data_processing.content: Clyde, our AI colleague, processes data as follows. For content, Clyde uses the brand voice, strategy, research and earlier feedback of the client concerned. Only the context needed for an assignment is sent to an AI provider. Clyde keeps a memory of conversations and feedback per client; how long it is retained is set out in article 6. The Lead Qualifier analyzes chat messages and form submissions to score and forward leads. Lead scoring is advisory; no automated decisions are made. For text we mainly use language models from Anthropic and OpenAI. By default, these providers do not use data received through their API to train their models, and they retain that data only for a limited period under their own terms. For research, product analysis, images, video and voice-overs we engage specialized providers; these are listed in article 5.

sub_processors.title: 5. Sub-processors
sub_processors.content:
We use the following sub-processors to deliver our services.
Infrastructure: Supabase (database and authentication, EU region Frankfurt), Vercel (hosting; server functions in Frankfurt, global CDN), Hetzner (our own server in the EU for automations, the knowledge base and post scheduling; the scheduling software Postiz runs there self-hosted), Upstash (queues and temporary storage) and Sentry (error reporting).
Language models and AI: Anthropic (text) and OpenAI (text and images), both under a contract with their Irish entity, with transfers to the US based on SCCs, Google Gemini (research and product analysis), Perplexity (research with source citations) and Voyage AI (making knowledge and memory searchable).
Images, video and audio: fal.ai (images and video for ads) ElevenLabs (voice-overs for ads) and Bunny.net (video playback on personal video pages; based in Slovenia).
Web data and SEO: Firecrawl (reading web pages), Apify (public social media data) and DataForSEO (search positions, keywords and mentions in AI answers).
Communication and channels: Resend (email), Cal.com (scheduling meetings), Meta (Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp Business), Telegram (messages to Clyde) and Recall.ai (recording and transcribing meetings, only if you have Clyde attend a meeting).
Payments: Stripe.
A complete and current list, with country of establishment and transfer safeguard per sub-processor, is maintained in our Data Processing Agreement. We notify subscribers at least 30 days in advance of new sub-processors.

data_retention.title: 6. Data retention
data_retention.content:
Active accounts: data is retained for the duration of the service agreement, except where a shorter period is stated below.
After termination: a 30-day export window is provided, after which all data is permanently deleted.
Clyde's memory and conversations: 6 months on Founding, 12 months on Growth and Professional, for as long as the account is active on Enterprise.
Chatbot conversations on client websites: anonymized after 30 days without the visitor's consent, deleted after 12 months with consent.
Instagram messages: the text and the sender and recipient ids are erased after 90 days; only counts remain.
Leads and applications via the website: 24 months.
Inbox conversations: 24 months after the last message.
Video uploads that are not published: 24 hours.
Answers to the AI Readiness Scan: 12 months (see article 9).
Billing records: retained in accordance with Dutch tax law (7 years).
The clean-up runs periodically, so data may remain for up to a month after the period has expired.

data_subject_rights.title: 7. Your rights
data_subject_rights.content: Under the GDPR, you have the right to: access your personal data and receive a copy, rectify inaccurate or incomplete personal data, erase your personal data (right to be forgotten), restrict the processing of your personal data, data portability (receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format), object to processing based on legitimate interest and withdraw consent at any time for consent-based processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@future-marketing.ai. We respond within 30 days as required by the GDPR.

international_transfers.title: 8. International data transfers
international_transfers.content: Some of our sub-processors are located outside the EU/EEA, mainly in the United States. For these transfers we rely on the following safeguards: the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) for certified US companies (including Vercel, Stripe, Google) and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission where DPF certification is not available. Where possible we use EU data center regions to minimize international transfers. We closely follow legal developments around international transfers, including any challenges to the DPF.

ai_readiness_assessment.title: 9. AI Readiness Assessment
ai_readiness_assessment.content: Our AI Readiness Scan at /assessment is an interactive questionnaire that produces a persona, scores and a recommended roadmap. What we collect: email address (upon confirmed sign-up), your answers to the sixteen questions, calculated scores and persona assignment, a hashed IP and user agent for rate limiting and abuse prevention, and a timestamp of your consent. Purpose: to deliver the report to you, improve the scan product and (only with explicit opt-in) send a newsletter about AI marketing. Legal basis: your consent (GDPR art. 6(1)(a)), captured via double opt-in. Retention: answers, scores and consent records are kept for 12 months and then deleted. Processors: Supabase (EU region) for storage, Resend for email delivery, Vercel for hosting. Your rights: you can withdraw, request access or deletion at any time via privacy@future-marketing.ai. We respond within 30 days.

platform_data.title: 10. Instagram and Facebook data (Meta platform data)
platform_data.content:
When a client connects an Instagram or Facebook business account, we receive the following through Meta's official APIs: the platform account id and username, public profile information, the content scheduled and published through our platform, and metrics about that content (reach, interactions, follower counts). If the client enables the inbox feature, we also receive messages and comments addressed to the connected account.

Purpose: scheduling, publishing and reporting on content on behalf of the client, and replying to messages within the connected account. We use this data for nothing else. We do not sell it, do not share it with advertisers, and do not use it for ad targeting or profiling outside the connected account.

Legal basis: performance of the contract with the agency (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)); for messages and comments, additionally the consent of the account holder who authorises the connection.

Retention: platform data is kept for as long as the connection is active. For messages, we erase the text and the sender and recipient ids after 90 days; only counts remain. As soon as the connection is removed, or the app is removed from the Instagram or Facebook account, we delete that account's platform identifiers and stored access tokens within 30 days. Content and reports already produced remain part of the agency's own records and are erased on request.

Deletion: remove the app through your Instagram or Facebook settings and send a request to privacy@future-marketing.ai, with the account's username. We delete the data within 30 days and confirm this by email.

We process this data in accordance with the Meta Platform Terms and the Meta Developer Policies.

voor.title: 11. Your personal video page (future-marketing.ai/voor)
voor.content:
If you replied to our email, we may send you a link to a personal page at future-marketing.ai/voor/ with a video about Clyde, your agency's AI colleague. This section covers that page.

Controller: Future Marketing AI, the Netherlands, reachable at privacy@future-marketing.ai.

Source: your name, your agency's name and your business email address come from our outreach: the email we sent you and your reply to it.

Purpose: preparing our conversation. We use this data for nothing else.

Without your consent we record: whether and when you opened the page, whether that was on a phone or a computer, whether you came back and whether you booked a meeting. We also count, across all viewers together, where people stop watching, without a name, page address or IP address. Legal basis: legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)), namely preparing the conversation you replied about.

With your consent we additionally record: how far you watched, which chapters you watched or rewatched, where you stopped and whether you clicked “Plan een gesprek” (book a call) without booking. This only happens if you turn on the switch below the video; it is off by default. Legal basis: consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)).

If you use the switch, we keep your choice with a random browser code, a sequence number and the version of the question below the video, so we can show what you chose and when. Your browser also keeps that choice in its local storage, and with your consent also where you left off in the video, so you can continue later. That saved position is kept only in your browser.

What we never do: derive your location from your IP address, record your visit, build heatmaps or recognise your browser by a fingerprint. We do not store your IP address or your full user agent. Our host Vercel, like any web server, keeps a request log with IP address and page address, under Vercel's own retention period.

Recipients: Bunny.net plays the video. Every viewer gets the same video, so Bunny.net sees no name and no page address. Cal.com handles your booking, but only if you click “Plan een gesprek” yourself; before that the page loads nothing from Cal.com. Upstash limits the number of requests and receives only a hash of your IP address for that, which expires after 21 minutes at most. Supabase (EU region Frankfurt) and Vercel process the data as hosting for our app and this site. Bunny.net is based in Slovenia. Cal.com, Upstash and Vercel are US companies, so their processing can take place outside the EU; the safeguards in article 8 apply to that transfer.

Retention: 90 days after the last contact. Contact means creating or resending the page, a booking or the start of the meeting; the latest moment counts. If you become a client, the client retention periods in section 6 apply. The count across all viewers contains no person and is kept.

Withdrawing consent: turn the switch off in the browser where you turned it on, or write to privacy@future-marketing.ai. As soon as your choice reaches us, we delete what we recorded with your consent; if sending fails at first, your browser tries again.

Your right to object (GDPR Art. 21): you can object at any time, by replying NEE (no) to our email or by writing to privacy@future-marketing.ai. As soon as we read your reply, we delete your page, everything we recorded on it and our copy of your booking, and we put your email address on our do-not-email list so we do not email you again. If you had already booked a meeting, we cancel it and remove it from Cal.com as well.

What remains afterwards: your email address on that do-not-email list, because without that entry we could email you again, and the emails we already sent you, in our sending records. We keep those records for 24 months after sending. After that we erase your email address and the text of those emails from them; only technical references to your reply and to our decision about it remain, so that we do not answer it twice.

Your other rights (access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability) are in section 7. If you disagree with how we handle your data, you can lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) via autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl.

contact.title: 12. Contact and supervisory authority
contact.content: Data controller: Future Marketing AI, the Netherlands. For privacy inquiries, data subject requests or complaints: privacy@future-marketing.ai. If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, AP) at autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl.
